name: garena development
postCreateCommand: conda run --name garena pip install --no-cache-dir -r GarenaBackend/requirements.txt && conda run --name garena npm ci --prefix GarenaPortal

postStartCommand.backend: nohup python -m uvicorn main:app --app-dir GarenaBackend --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload --reload-dir GarenaBackend >/tmp/garena-backend.log 2>&1 &
